shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'components/**' | head -200"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- tree ---\\n' && rg --files src"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/components 2>/dev/null | head -80; rg "SegmentMenu|Toggle" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head'
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 2 -type d | head -40 && rg \"export .*Segment\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' -l | head"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts && sed -n 1,140p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && cat src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui && rg '\"@gravity-ui/icons\"' package-lock.json | head"
/bin/bash -lc "rg '\"(ChartColumn|GraphIcon|ChartLine|LineChart|Activity|ChartArea|Pulse|Dashboard|Wave|Database|Server)\"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons -maxdepth 2 -type f | head; rg 'export \\{ default as Chart' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc "rg 'Pulse|Activity|Gauge|Monitor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg \"LazyLoader\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts && rg \"export type ControlGroupOption|interface ControlGroupOption\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts -A35"
/bin/bash -lc "rg \"LazyLoader\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -g '*.d.ts' -n | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg "LazyLoader" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -n | head -30; rg "export declare const Spinner|Spinner" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head'
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -80; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg 'Loader|Spinner|Skeleton' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Loader/Loader.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Skeleton/Skeleton.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || ls /usr/local/bin/apply_patch /usr/bin/apply_patch 2>/dev/null || true
which apply_patch
echo $PATH'
/bin/bash -lc 'find / -name apply_patch -type f 2>/dev/null | head'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/visualization/types.ts && rg "React" src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx && cat dist/.vite/manifest.json 2>/dev/null || true'

/bin/bash -lc 'nohup npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 >/tmp/vite.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/vite.pid
sleep 1
cat /tmp/vite.log
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5173 >/tmp/page.html
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5173/src/App.tsx | head -20'
/bin/bash -lc "command -v playwright || command -v chromium || command -v google-chrome || true; ps -ef | grep -E 'vite|node' | grep -v grep"

/bin/bash -lc "pkill -f 'vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173' 2>/dev/null || true
git status --short
git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx; printf '\\n--- sales ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' src/visualization/SalesChartEngine.tsx; printf '\\n--- monitoring ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' src/visualization/MonitoringChartEngine.tsx; printf '\\n--- utils ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' src/visualization/chart-utils.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git status --short'
